description: Build a shared MarkdownReader component and migrate issue description, issue comments, and artifact Markdown surfaces to use it.

tasks.title: Build shared MarkdownReader component
tasks.description: Add a reusable MarkdownReader component under packages/web/src/shared/ui/markdown-reader/ built on the existing react-markdown + remark-gfm + Tailwind typography stack. Implement the full MarkdownReaderProps contract (content, baseHeadingLevel, mode, collapsedHeight, showToc, showHeadingAnchors, showCopyCode, className), h1-h6 heading remap via react-markdown component overrides clamped to h6, table wrapping in a horizontal-scroll container, code-block overflow with optional copy-code via navigator.clipboard (feature-detected), overflow-wrap:anywhere for links/inline code/long paths, and Reader-owned full/collapsible long-document modes with ResizeObserver-based measurement against collapsedHeight (default 600). Export MarkdownReader and MarkdownReaderProps from the shared UI barrel. MarkdownContent behavior (code/pre overrides, inline code styling) is folded into the Reader's internal renderer, not kept as a separate public export.
acceptanceCriteria: MarkdownReader is importable from the shared UI barrel and renders Markdown content (paragraphs, headings, lists, links, emphasis, inline code, fenced code, blockquotes, rules) as formatted document content.
baseHeadingLevel shifts rendered heading elements: with baseHeadingLevel={3}, '#'/'##'/'###' render as h3/h4/h5; heading levels clamp at h6 and never exceed it.
With baseHeadingLevel > 1, an embedded Markdown '# heading' does not render as an h1 element.
A fenced code block with a very long line scrolls horizontally inside the code block and does not introduce page-level horizontal overflow in the test layout.

With showCopyCode enabled, a copy affordance renders on fenced code blocks and activating it calls navigator.clipboard.writeText with the block text; with showCopyCode omitted, no copy affordance renders.
A wide Markdown table scrolls horizontally inside its wrapper and does not expand the page width or introduce page-level horizontal overflow.
A long bare URL or link and a long inline code path/identifier wrap or break inside their container without producing page-level horizontal overflow.

In mode='collapsible', content taller than collapsedHeight (default 600) initially renders constrained with an Expand control and gradient overlay; activating Expand reveals full content and exposes a Collapse control; activating Collapse restores the constrained view. In mode='full', no collapse control renders. In mode='collapsible' with content shorter than the threshold, no Expand control renders.
With showToc enabled, a compact table of contents derived from headings renders; with showHeadingAnchors enabled, headings expose anchor affordances; with both omitted, neither renders.
Component tests in MarkdownReader.test.tsx cover heading remapping, code overflow, table containment, long link/path wrapping, and full vs collapsible modes.
Web test suite, lint, and typecheck pass after this task.
tasks.output: packages/web/src/shared/ui/markdown-reader/MarkdownReader.tsx plus building-block helpers (heading remap, table wrapper, copy-code button) and MarkdownReader.test.tsx; shared UI barrel export.
tasks.notes: Default baseHeadingLevel=2, default mode='full', default collapsedHeight=600, all show* props default false. Preserve the existing inline-code styling (px-1 py-0.5 bg-gray-100 rounded text-xs font-mono) so REQ-WUI-ISSUE-MARKDOWN-002 visual is unchanged. Fold MarkdownContent's code/pre overrides into the Reader's internal renderer.

tasks.title: Migrate Issue Detail description and comments to MarkdownReader
tasks.description: Update packages/web/src/pages/issue-detail/ui/IssueDetailPage.tsx to render the issue description and each comment through MarkdownReader instead of the page-local MarkdownContent. Remove descriptionExpanded, descriptionBodyRef, isOverflowing, the scrollHeight > 600 useEffect, the max-h-[600px] clip, the gradient overlay, the Expand/Collapse Button, and the MarkdownContent helper. Render the description with mode='collapsible' collapsedHeight=600 baseHeadingLevel=2 so long-document collapse becomes a Reader-level concern and embedded '#' headings no longer create a page-level h1 landmark. Render each comment with mode='full' baseHeadingLevel=3. Update IssueDetailPage.test.tsx to assert Reader-based Expand/Collapse behavior (appears for long, hidden for short/empty, toggles correctly), to assert embedded '#' renders as h2 not h1, and to remove the scrollHeight-spy-based assertions.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue description renders through MarkdownReader and IssueDetailPage no longer defines or renders a local MarkdownContent.

IssueDetailPage source contains no descriptionExpanded, descriptionBodyRef, isOverflowing, scrollHeight > 600, max-h-[600px] clip, or gradient overlay; collapse/expand is delegated to MarkdownReader mode='collapsible'.
An issue description starting with '# Heading' does not render an h1 for that heading; the issue page title remains the only page-level h1 landmark on Issue Detail.
Each issue comment body renders through MarkdownReader and comment timestamps/delete actions remain available.
Long description collapses by default with a Reader-level Expand control; activating Expand reveals full content and exposes Collapse; short and empty descriptions render no Expand/Collapse control.
Updated IssueDetailPage.test.tsx asserts Reader-level collapse behavior and the no-duplicate-h1 behavior, and no longer uses scrollHeight spying.
Web test suite, lint, and typecheck pass after this task.
tasks.notes: Description wiring: <MarkdownReader content={issue.body} mode='collapsible' collapsedHeight={600} baseHeadingLevel={2} />. Comment wiring: <MarkdownReader content={comment.body} baseHeadingLevel={3} />. Satisfies the web-ui delta requirements REQ-WUI-ISSUE-MARKDOWN-001/002/003.

tasks.title: Render Markdown artifacts through MarkdownReader
tasks.description: Update packages/web/src/widgets/issue-workflow/ui/ArtifactContentViewer.tsx so that when data.kind === 'text' and data.contentType === 'text/markdown', the recorded content renders through MarkdownReader (baseHeadingLevel=2) instead of the plain <pre> block. Non-Markdown text content keeps the existing <pre whitespace-pre-wrap break-words> rendering unchanged. Update WorkflowArtifacts.test.tsx and/or WorkflowTaskArtifact.test.tsx so that opening a Markdown artifact (e.g. proposal.md, review.md, or a directory entry with contentType text/markdown) asserts rendered Markdown (such as a heading element) rather than a <pre> block, and so a non-Markdown text artifact still renders inside <pre>.
acceptanceCriteria: ArtifactContentViewer renders Markdown content (contentType === 'text/markdown') through MarkdownReader with baseHeadingLevel=2.
Non-Markdown text content still renders through the existing <pre whitespace-pre-wrap break-words> block unchanged.
Opening a Markdown artifact (e.g. review.md with content '# Title') shows rendered formatted content (e.g. an h2 from the remapped '# Title') rather than a raw <pre> block.
Directory-artifact Markdown entries (e.g. workflow.md with contentType text/markdown) also render through MarkdownReader when selected.
Updated artifact tests assert Markdown rendering via MarkdownReader for .md artifacts and plain <pre> rendering for non-Markdown text.
Web test suite, lint, and typecheck pass after this task.
tasks.output: Updated packages/web/src/widgets/issue-workflow/ui/ArtifactContentViewer.tsx and the relevant artifact tests (WorkflowArtifacts.test.tsx / WorkflowTaskArtifact.test.tsx).
tasks.notes: Only branch on data.kind === 'text' && data.contentType === 'text/markdown'. Do not change the artifact API, content model, or directory listing behavior. ReviewReportModal and session-transcript Markdown surfaces are explicitly out of scope (follow-up).
